user.title: Hattrick
user.description: Choose how to connect your Hattrick account.

manual.title: CHPP credentials
manual.description: Enter the credentials obtained by registering an app on chpp.hattrick.org and authorizing it on your account.

auth.title: Authorize on Hattrick
auth.description:
1. Open {authorize_url} in your browser and log in to Hattrick.
2. Click "Allow".
3. Copy the verifier code shown and paste it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authorize Hattrick
reauth_confirm.description: The access token has been revoked. Open {authorize_url} in your browser, click "Allow" and paste the new verifier.

app.title: CHPP app
app.description: Enter the Consumer Key and Consumer Secret of your app registered on chpp.hattrick.org (Community → CHPP → your app).

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to CHPP. Please try again later.

abort.already_configured: This Hattrick account is already configured.

data.matchday: Matchday mode (5 min polling during match windows)

get_match_details.name: Match details
get_match_details.description: Fetches match details from CHPP (goals, possession, shots, ratings, weather, referee) and returns them as the service response.

match_id.name: Match ID
match_id.description: MatchID of the match (e.g. from the match_id attribute of the next match sensor).

config_entry.name: Team (config entry)
config_entry.description: Optional: which configured team to use, if you have more than one.

get_player.name: Player details
get_player.description: Fetches a player's data from CHPP (skills, form, TSI, salary, injuries) and returns it as the service response.

player_id.name: Player ID
player_id.description: PlayerID of the player (e.g. from the giocatori attribute of the squad sensor).

config_entry.name: Team (config entry)
config_entry.description: Optional: which configured team to use, if you have more than one.
